description: Lifecycle of the session every authorization check is evaluated against. The check itself is one request and one response and has no state of its own.

anonymous.description: A reference exists and names no account. Real, storable, and enough to own a cart.

CREDENTIAL_VERIFIED.description: The same reference is bound to an account; id and created-at survive.

EXPIRY_ELAPSED.description: An abandoned anonymous session evicts by TTL like any other.

REVOKE_SESSION.guard: an operator revoked the client, not the principal

authenticated.description: Bound to an account and inside its expiry window. Checks may now match grants.

EXPIRY_ELAPSED.description: Absolute deadline reached. Never extended in place — a refresh issues a new session.

ACCOUNT_ERASED.description: A session must not outlive the account it speaks for.

single-factor.description: One proof presented. A permission with requires-multi-factor is denied here.

SECOND_FACTOR_VERIFIED.description: Elevation in place — strength changes, identity does not.

multi-factor.description: Two proofs presented. Every grant the principal holds is now reachable.

STEP_DOWN_ELAPSED.guard: elevation window of 15 minutes has passed
STEP_DOWN_ELAPSED.description: Elevation is time-boxed; the session itself continues.

expired.description: Evicted by TTL. A resolution finds nothing, and acl denies — the same answer as an unknown reference.

revoked.description: Explicitly ended. The record survives its reference so the principal can be told why.
